cc:Work.dc:description: q is the assumed probability of the opponent taking the first action. A deterministic added cost is applied to race / escalate / local lockdown, respectively; the Stag Hunt intervention here differs from an assurance payment for nonlinear risk criteria. Zero means already weakly optimal. N/A means no threshold found within [0, 100]. Default criterion parameters and numerical tolerances are saved with all 54 derivations.
